prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1356; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a vehicle that entered from the cross street. Police report requested. Initial liability appears to favor the insured pending witness statements.

Entry 2: Recorded statement obtained from insured. Insured states the light was green for their direction of travel. Photos of both vehicles received showing damage to the driver side door, quarter panel and rear wheel well on the insured vehicle. Tow yard location confirmed and vehicle inspection scheduled.

Entry 3: Claimant has retained counsel. All further communication to be routed through the attorney's office. Attorney letter of representation received and logged. Medical authorization and bodily injury demand package requested from counsel. Claimant reports lower back strain with muscle spasm and limited range of motion. Treating physician records requested.

Entry 4: Field appraisal completed on insured vehicle. Estimate prepared for body and frame repairs. Rental coverage confirmed under insured policy. Adverse carrier contacted to discuss liability allocation and subrogation interest. Their insured disputes signal status and has indicated a possible counterclaim.

Entry 5: Independent intersection video obtained from nearby business and reviewed. Footage appears to support insured's account of the signal phase. Liability assessment updated to reflect majority fault on the other driver. Reserve adjusted for property damage and bodily injury exposure. File referred for supervisor review before any settlement discussion with counsel.
